newsitem.title: USA: Smedvig files for 8 mln shr global offer.
newsitem.headline: Smedvig files for 8 mln shr global offer.

text.p: Smedvig A/S, a Norwegian offshore drilling and oil services company, said on Friday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of eight million Class B ordinary shares.
Smedvig also said it applied to the New York Stock Exchange to list its Class A and Class B ordinary shares as American depositary receipts.
The company said it would offer seven million new shares and the Smedvig family holding company, Summa AS, would offer another one million. Net proceeds would be used for capital spending program.
Smedvig said the offering would be made in three tranches -- 5.5 million B shares in the United States, 1.5 million in the international market and one million in Norway.
Morgan Stanley & Co Inc would coordinate the deal.
